$doc: About-us page animation spec — Webflow IX2 → GSAP conversion. Companion doc: about-us-animations.md. Raw decoded IX2 source: webflow-ix2-about-us.raw.json (34 events, filtered from the same site-wide registry as home/menu/contact-us).

meta.engine: Webflow IX2, shared registry with home/menu/contact-us
meta.sharedRecipes: riseBlurFade (a-10/a-33/a-48), fade (a-32/a-46), zoom-settle (a-34), Ken Burns (a-51-equivalent) — all defined in home-animations.json. Not redefined here.

parallaxZoomContinuous.description: actionList a-56 — unlike home's one-shot Ken Burns (settle once, stop), this scales an element continuously across its ENTIRE time in the viewport: scale 1 at the moment it enters, scale 1.2 by the moment it leaves. A true scroll-scrubbed parallax, not a settle animation.

tabPanelFade.description: actionList a-58 — a plain 500ms opacity fade (delay 100ms, easeIn) used both for the tabs-wrap's scroll entrance and, repurposed, for the swap between tab panels on click in the vertical collection showcase.

teamPhotoHover.description: actionLists a-77/a-78 — team card photo scale 1 -> 1.08 on hover (600ms inOutQuad), back to 1 on mouse-out (500ms). Identical shape to the product-card hover already built for home/menu (a-43/a-44) — same CSS group-hover technique reused, not re-implemented as GSAP.

slideInBottom.description: New direction on the site's slideIn family (siblings: slideInRight on home/contact, slideInLeft on menu). Used here for FAQ accordion rows: y+100px, opacity 0 -> in place, opacity 1, 1000ms outQuart.
